name: empty announcement versus useful navigation
problem: It is important to note that the queue retains failed jobs for 7 days.
legitimate: The installation note explains why the queue retains failed jobs for 7 days.

name: generic scene-setting versus relevant context
problem: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, the queue retains failed jobs for 7 days.
legitimate: During a network outage, the queue retains failed jobs for 7 days.

name: performative emphasis versus literal truth claim
problem: Make no mistake, the queue retains failed jobs for 7 days.
legitimate: We could not establish the truth of that claim from the logs.

name: repeated contrast scaffolding versus useful contrast
problem:
It is not a queue; it is a foundation.
It is not a retry; it is a journey.
It is not a log; it is a transformation.
legitimate: It is not a failed payment; it is a delayed confirmation. Check the receipt before retrying.

name: accidental determiner duplication versus legitimate grammatical repetition
problem: Read the the receipt before retrying.
legitimate: They had had the receipt since Monday. That that receipt survived surprised us.

name: empty framing versus calibrated scientific uncertainty
problem: It's worth noting that most samples may remain stable for about 7 days (Lee et al., 2025) [1].
legitimate: Most samples may remain stable for about 7 days (Lee et al., 2025) [1].

name: author prose versus quoted language
problem: It is important to note that the deadline moved.
legitimate:
The witness said, "It is important to note that the deadline moved."
> Make no mistake, this is testimony.
`the the` is the exact search string.

name: announcement versus bibliography
problem: In this section, we will discuss the retry endpoint.
legitimate:
See [1] and [guide][retry].

name: generic lead versus precise technical terminology
problem: In the modern world, the API returns a powerful result.
legitimate: A powerful electromagnet unlocks the latch. The seamless pipe carries water; the passive sensor may report slowly.

name: empty announcement versus dialect and intentional rhetorical form
problem: It is crucial to note that the gate closed.
legitimate: We ain't moving till the gate opens. We wait, we watch, we listen. Why wait? Because the gate's shut - and the guard knows it.

name: announcement versus causal attribution and cautious claim
problem: It is essential to note that some witnesses could not identify the actor [@lee2025].
legitimate: According to Lee [@lee2025], some witnesses could not identify the actor; the records were damaged.
